review.headline: One stuck ownfoil verification loop ate two-thirds of today's log volume; everything else is minor.

items.diagnosis: ownfoil's worker-2 has been retrying verification of The_Sinking_City_v0_ROMSLAB.nsp 4000 times overnight, failing the same PFS0 partition check every time. Combined with its paired log line, this is 64% of all matched lines today — a retry loop, not intermittent noise.
items.fix: Delete The_Sinking_City_v0_ROMSLAB.nsp from ownfoil's library so the worker stops requeuing it, then re-add from a clean source if needed.

items.diagnosis: Prowlarr hit the LimeTorrents rate limit, which disabled the indexer for Sonarr until 05:27 and separately backed off kapowarr's query for 14087s. Low volume tonight, but it's the same indexer tripping limits across two stacks.
items.fix: In Prowlarr, lower the query interval or set an explicit per-indexer rate limit for LimeTorrents so Sonarr/Kapowarr stop racing it.

items.diagnosis: Radarr's VideoFileInfoReader/DetectSample failures (this plus 843bd0cd437d and 89aec2eeb322) still account for roughly 14% of matched lines from files ffprobe can't read or whose EBML header is corrupt. Still unfixed, still filling the error log daily.
items.fix: Run `docker exec radarr ffprobe -version` to confirm the binary is intact, then spot-check the offending files (e.g. rasputin (1996)) for corruption and reprocess or redownload them.

mute.why: netdata's spawn-server plugin restarts (paired with 82278af27950 and b4a4f3c0319b) are internal collector churn, not service impact, and too low-volume to ever indicate a real spike.
